content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

# Fork pull requests get this same read-only token and no secrets, so a
# contributor's branch can run the suite without being handed anything.
permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Formatting and lint findings are reported, not corrected, in CI. Correcting
  # them here would mean granting a workflow write access to the repository and
  # would still leave fork pull requests to fix by hand, so the same check runs
  # from a pre-commit hook, where `npm run lint:fix` is one command away.
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm

      - run: npm ci

      - run: npm run lint

      # The API reference in the README is generated from the source, down to
      # the line numbers its links point at, so any change under src leaves it
      # stale until it is rebuilt.
      - name: Check the generated README is current
        run: npm run docs:check

  test:
    name: test-${{ matrix.node-version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node-version: ['20', '22', '24', '25']

    steps:
      # Third-party actions are pinned to a commit, not a tag: a tag is
      # mutable and this workflow runs on pull requests from forks.
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: npm

      - run: npm ci

      - run: ./coverage.sh
        name: Run tests

      - uses: codecov/codecov-action@fb8b3582c8e4def4969c97caa2f19720cb33a72f # v7.0.0
        with:
          # Tokenless upload; public repositories do not need a token, and a
          # fork pull request would not have access to one anyway.
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  # The oldest node `engines` claims. The dev toolchain (mocha, tsx, c8) and the
  # lockfile's npm version both need a modern node, so the suite itself cannot
  # run here; instead this builds dist on a current node and requires it under
  # node 12, which is what a consumer on an old runtime does and the only place
  # emitted-syntax regressions show up.
  smoke:
    name: smoke-12
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm

      - run: npm ci

      - run: npm run build

      # Switching the active node after the build; nothing below runs npm, so
      # node 12's bundled npm 6 never has to read the lockfile.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '12'

      - run: node test/node-12-smoke.js
        name: Run dist smoke test
